did.unittitle: Calhoun College, Yale University, records of the Master
did.abstract: The records consist of administrative files maintained by the master of Calhoun College, Yale University. Records include commencement files, records of the college fellows, freshman faculty advising, housing and Master's Teas.

odd.head: General
odd.p: Forms part of Yale Record Group 13-E-2 (YRG 13-E-2), Records of the master of Calhoun College.

prefercite.head: Preferred Citation
prefercite.p: Calhoun College, Yale University, Records of the Master (RU 1209). Manuscripts and Archives, Yale University Library.

bioghist.head: Biographical / Historical
bioghist.p: The title "Master" for chief executive officers of residential colleges was changed to "Head of College" in April of 2016.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The records consist of administrative files maintained by the master of Calhoun College, Yale University. Records include commencement files, records of the college fellows, freshman faculty advising, housing and Master's Teas.
